reference_answer: No, the driver will only deliver the item to the curb or your front door. They do not carry heavy items inside.

Shipping Policy > Heavy items

Items over 40 lb are heavy items. Today these are the Cedar Chest (52 lb) and the Teak Garden Bench (61 lb). Heavy items ship by Standard only and are delivered curbside, which means the driver leaves the item at the curb or the front door and does not carry it inside. Shipping Policy > Tracking
A tracking number is emailed within 24 hours after your order ships. We choose the carrier (UPS, USPS or FedEx), and you cannot request a specific carrier. An order can ship in more than one package. If it does, shipping is charged once.

Shipping Policy > Signature on delivery
Orders with a total of $300 or more require a signature on delivery. If nobody can sign, the carrier will try again the next business day and then hold the package at a local facility.

Shipping Policy > Holiday season
From November 1 to December 24, processing can take up to 2 extra business days. To arrive by December 24, order by these dates: Standard by December 10, Expedited by December 17, and Overnight by December 22 before 12:00 noon PT. We do not guarantee Christmas delivery for orders placed after those dates.

Shipping Policy > Lost packages
If tracking shows no movement for 7 business days, contact support. We open an investigation with the carrier, which takes up to 10 business days. When it finishes, we either send a replacement or refund the order, and you choose which.

question: hey my cart total is way higher than what i saw before, why?
reference_answer: The total changes because shipping, tax, and the $19.95 heavy-item surcharge are only added at checkout. Tax is calculated based on your specific shipping address.
source_text:
Website and Checkout Help > Supported browsers

Our website works best on the current and previous major versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported. If checkout misbehaves, try a different browser or a private window before contacting support.

Website and Checkout Help > Creating a cart and saving items
Items stay in your cart for 30 days if you are signed in and for 7 days if you are a guest and your browser keeps cookies. Putting an item in a cart does not reserve it. If an item sells out while it is in your cart, it is removed at checkout.

Website and Checkout Help > Wish lists and restock alerts
Signed-in customers can save items to a wish list. On an out-of-stock product page, choose Notify Me and enter your email. We send one email when the item is back. A restock email does not hold the item for you, so popular items can sell out again quickly.

Website and Checkout Help > Applying a promo code
Enter the code in the Promo Code box on the cart page and select Apply. The discount shows before you pay. If a code is rejected, check that the order meets the minimum, that the items are not Final Sale and that you have only one code applied. Codes are not case sensitive.

Website and Checkout Help > Why did my payment fail?
The most common reasons are a mistyped card number, a billing address that does not match the bank's records and a bank block on online purchases. Try again, try another payment method, or ask your bank to approve the charge. A failed payment never creates an order, and we do not keep a hold on your card.

Website and Checkout Help > Why is my total different from the cart?
Shipping and tax are added at checkout. Tax depends on your shipping address. The heavy-item surcharge of $19.95 per heavy item also appears only at checkout, in the shipping line.

question: If I accidentally use a metal utensil on my Tidewell Enameled Dutch Oven and it scratches the surface, is this covered under my warranty?
reference_answer: No, this is not covered. While the enamel has a 10-year warranty against chipping, cracking, and crazing, the warranty explicitly excludes damage caused by metal utensils, which are known to scratch the enamel.
source_text:
Warranty > Dutch Oven enamel warranty

The Tidewell Enameled Dutch Oven has a longer warranty on its enamel: 10 years from the delivery date. It covers chipping, cracking and crazing of the enamel under normal home use. It does not cover damage from sudden temperature change, impact, metal utensils or steel wool. All other parts of the Dutch Oven, including the lid knob, have the standard 1-year warranty.

Warranty > What the warranty covers
It covers defects in materials and workmanship, such as a seam that splits under normal use, a hinge that fails, a zipper that breaks or a coating that peels without being misused.

---

Kitchen Products > Tidewell Enameled Dutch Oven (5.5 qt)

The Dutch Oven is enameled cast iron and weighs 12.4 lb. It comes in three colors: Sea Glass, Oat and Charcoal. It is oven safe to 500°F (260°C). The lid knob is rated only to 450°F (232°C), so use the lid at lower temperatures or swap the knob. It works on gas, electric, ceramic and induction cooktops. We recommend hand washing. It is dishwasher safe, but repeated dishwasher cycles can dull the enamel over time.

Kitchen Products > Dutch Oven care
Use wooden or silicone utensils. Metal utensils can scratch the enamel. Do not heat the empty pot on high heat, and do not put a hot pot into cold water, because sudden temperature change can crack the enamel. Soak stuck-on food in warm water and use a nylon scrubber. Do not use steel wool.
